title: Benchmark run provenance (v1)
description: UND-13 (noema#199, Codex P1). Which results one scoring run read, written beside scorecard.json as provenance.json. `results_sha256` is the digest of the result set the scorer read (canonical JSON, results ordered by case_id); `scorecard_sha256` is the digest of the scorecard it wrote; `context_sha256` is the digest of what the results were scored against (the case set, the oracle set and the pack), so repeat scorecards rescored against another pack or oracle set are told from the primary's. When the scoring run was given the four other runs for pass^k, `pass_k_runs` lists all five runs (the primary first) with each result set's digest, so a qualification can check that the repeat scorecards it is shown are the runs the pass^k rests on and not four unrelated clean ones. Without repeats `pass_k_runs` is null. The reference implementation is benchmark/scoring/provenance.py. SYNTHETIC in tests (AGENT-25).
